### 2026-10-05 — So for this project I just started off by following the guide step by step, going through the instructions one by one to get everything set up. It was going pretty smooth at first, but honestly the tr

**8h**

So for this project I just started off by following the guide step by step, going through the instructions one by one to get everything set up. It was going pretty smooth at first, but honestly the trickiest part was definitely making the custom cutout for the PCB shape... took me a while to get the edge cuts layer right.

Also figuring out all the final wiring connections near the end was kinda confusing and took a lot of guessing and checking to make sure stuff was hooked up right. On top of that, at one point I totally forgot to save my work and KiCad closed or crashed, so I lost a bunch of progress on the layout. Had to redo a whole section which sucked and made the whole thing take WAY longer than it should’ve haha.
